summary: DEFECT FOUND AND FIXED in this folder's own cad/part.py: RADXA_LONG_SPAN = 54.7 was a by-eye misread of the §4 raster taken as the mounting-hole pitch along the 65 mm axis. It is not the hole pitch — the holes measure 57.8429 mm apart, and 54.7 dimensions a connector feature line (measured at 54.5186 / 54.8379 mm from the top edge). A carrier drilled to 54.7 would miss all four holes by 1.57 mm. part.py corrected the same day; the default 'mesh' build was never affected.
by: claude opus-5, microduck night shift lane C

summary: SKU NOT SETTLED, narrowed. Radxa §7 p.8 offers 32 GB eMMC ONLY with 4 GB DRAM (RS107-D4E32H1W15/H0W15); 1 GB DRAM pairs with no eMMC or 8 GB. Pollen's store listing says '1GB RAM + 32GB storage' and Pollen's updater design says the storage it rewrites is eMMC (updater-design.md:592,:718). Two options survive: an ODM 1 GB + 32 GB build, or RS107-D1E0H1W15 with the 32 GB being the microSD. One `lsblk` + `/proc/meminfo` on a production robot settles it.
by: claude opus-5, microduck night shift lane C
